data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2025 runs from 21 to 29 June, and Marbella transforms into a week-long fiesta of flamenco, fairground rides and late-night parties. But the real insider move? Skip the crowded fairground for a few hours and take the party to the sea. A Marbella boat rental for Feria San Bernabé 2025 gives you the same celebration with a Mediterranean backdrop, a private deck and zero queues for the bar.

Why Rent a Boat During Feria San Bernabé?

The fair is fantastic, but it's also hot, loud and packed. A boat charter lets you escape the crowds, cool off with a swim in the open sea, and still make it back to Puerto Banús in time for the evening fireworks. You'll see Marbella's coastline from a new angle — the Golden Mile villas, the Sierra Blanca foothills, and the iconic La Concha mountain towering behind the marina.

With our fleet departing from Puerto Banús, you're only a 10-minute walk from the fairground's main entrance. That means you can combine both experiences: a morning at the fair, an afternoon on the water, and back for the night-time festivities.

Best Boats for a Feria Party

For groups of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) is the ultimate party platform. It's fast, spacious and comes with a free jet ski — perfect for those who want a thrill between swim stops. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offers a shaded saloon and an open flybridge, ideal for socialising. If you're a smaller group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) or Azimut 39 (12.5m) are agile and well-equipped, and both are available at the €749/2h rate.

Here's a quick comparison of our most popular party boats:

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden costs. Every boat rental includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). On board you'll find water, soft drinks, beer, white wine and cava, plus light snacks. That means you can step on board with nothing but your sunglasses and a swimsuit.

  • Licensed skipper (no licence needed)
  • Fuel and full insurance
  • Drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Safety equipment and life jackets
  • All taxes included

Where to Anchor and Swim

From Puerto Banús, you can head east towards Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés — two sheltered coves with crystal-clear water, perfect for anchoring and jumping off the bow. If you prefer a livelier vibe, anchor near the Río Verde beach, where you'll see other boats doing the same. For a longer trip, cruise to Cabopino or even Estepona — the skipper will advise based on the day's conditions.

Most charters last 2–4 hours, but you can extend to a full day (8 hours) if you want to explore further. The Mangusta 80 can reach 40 knots, so you can cover more coastline in less time.

Feria San Bernabé 2025 Dates and Tips

The fair officially runs from 21 to 29 June 2025, with the main fairground located in the Arroyo de las Cañas area. Expect daytime family activities, evening casetas (marquee bars), and nightly fireworks. Boat charters are busiest on the weekend (27–29 June), so book early to secure your preferred slot.

Tip: book a morning or early afternoon charter to avoid the heat, then return to Puerto Banús for a sunset drink at one of the marina's beach clubs. Many of our guests combine a 2-hour boat ride with a late lunch at a chiringuito on the water.

How to Book Your Marbella Boat Rental for Feria San Bernabé 2025

Booking is straightforward. Choose your boat from our fleet, send us a WhatsApp with your preferred date and time, and we'll confirm availability within a few hours. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book directly at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719.

For all other boats (Ferretti 94, Canados 86, K80, etc.), request a personalised quote via WhatsApp — we'll respond with availability and a firm price. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance for Feria week.

Ready to set sail? Check out our main boat rental page to see the full fleet, or explore more rental options in Marbella. If you're planning a longer stay, consider a full-day charter to make the most of the coast. And for those who want the ultimate luxury, the Mangusta 80 is the flagship choice.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best boat for a Feria San Bernabé party?

For a group of up to 12, the Azimut 58 Flybridge or the Mangusta 80 offer plenty of deck space, a flybridge for sunbathing and a saloon for dancing. If you're a smaller group (up to 9), the Astondoa 40 is a nimble and stylish choice. All depart from Puerto Banús, so you can start celebrating as soon as you step aboard.

How much does a boat rental cost during Feria San Bernabé?

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, including skipper, drinks and VAT. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, and that includes a free jet ski. For other boats like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Is the skipper included in the price?

Yes, every charter includes a licensed skipper. You don't need a boating licence, and the skipper will handle navigation, mooring and safety. They'll also know the best spots for swimming and anchoring, so you can focus on the party.

What drinks and snacks are provided on board?

All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine and cava, plus light snacks like crisps, nuts and olives. If you want something more substantial, you can arrange a catering package — just let us know when you book via WhatsApp.

Can we bring our own music and decorations?

Absolutely. Most of our boats have Bluetooth speakers, so you can play your own playlist. You're welcome to bring decorations for a birthday or special occasion, but please avoid confetti that can harm marine life. Let the skipper know in advance if you're planning something elaborate.

What is the cancellation policy for Feria week?

Given the high demand during Feria San Bernabé, we recommend booking early. Cancellations made more than 7 days before the charter are fully refundable. Within 7 days, a 50% fee applies; within 48 hours, no refund. We'll always try to rebook you on another date if possible.

Do we need to bring any documents?

Just bring a valid ID or passport for each guest, and a credit card for the security deposit (if applicable). The skipper will handle all the nautical paperwork. Remember to bring sunscreen, a hat and a swimsuit — you'll want to jump in the water.
